## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project cilium --cilium-config-map FILE --from 1.16.19 --to 1.17.18 --cilium-distribution official_upstream|custom_build --cilium-config-complete --cilium-config-precedence-resolved (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--cilium-config-map-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```
